commit_message:
feat(au): the retry and http settings take effect; metrics_enabled removed (#25)

submit_task builds a RetryPolicy from the retry_* settings when retry_enabled
and no retry_policy is passed; au.http.serve defaults to the http_* settings;
metrics_enabled, which nothing read, is dropped with a FutureWarning for config
files and AU_METRICS_ENABLED that still set it.
